content: David Keila-neggwebur-bendaksad
David wisguargua, Filistea-sordamar Keila-neggweburgi gwichigusmarye, degine, e-ibmar-gwag-sabolebukwad ei atur-imaksamarbarye.

Degidbali, David Bab-Jehováʼse idakded, ega sogded: —Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿Filistea-sordamargi an bila-ononaoe? Bab-Jehová abin-sogded: —Be nae. Filistea-sordamargi be bila-ononae. Keila-neggwebur be bendaknae.

Ar sordamar Davidʼga sogdemalad: —Ar anmar amba wegi Judá-yalagi gudimar-inigwele, degite, amba anmar dobe-itodimalad. Anmar Keila-neggwebur-bendakega Filistea-sordamargi bila-ononader, bur bule anmar gwakidoed.
David gannar Bab-Jehováʼse idakdebalid. Geb Bab-Jehová weyob abin-imaksad: —Keila-neggweburse be nae, ar Filistea-sordamar an bega urmakoed.

Degisoggu, David e-sordaganmala Keila-neggweburse nadmalad. Geb Filistea-sordamargi bila-onosmalad. Geb agine, Filistea-sordamar ese galakusmalad. David Keila-neggweburginmalad-bendaksad, deginbali, Filisteaʼmar-ibe ibmar-durgan susbalid.
Ar Ahimelec-machi-Abiatar, David-walik-dukuega Keila-neggweburse-wakitegua, mor-efodʼye-nugad sesad.
Saúl, David-balegichad

Saúlʼga sogsamargua David Keila-neggweburse nadye, Saúl sogded: “¡Bab-Dummad anga David-urmaksa! Emide, David neggwebur-yawagak-nikad-yaba, degi, yawagak-esgorogi-atied-yaba dogsad, degisoggu, gege wakinned.”
Geb degine, Saúl bela e-sordamarse gochad, adi, David-sordamargi bila-ononamalaga, deginbali, Keila-neggwebur-ebiris bukumarbaligar.
David Saúl-e-oburgwebied wisgusad. Degisoggu, Abiatarʼga igar-uksad, ega mor-efodʼye-nugad sedegar.
A-sorbali, David, Bab-Dummadse gochad: —Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, an nue-wisid, an-ular Saúl Keila-neggwebur-obelogega dagsokalid.
Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, an bese wilege, anga be soge, ¿Keila-dulemar Saúlʼga an-urmakoe? ¿Anga-sogsamaladyobi, Saúl nue-danikoe? Bab-Jehová, Davidʼga sogded: —Eye, Saúl danikoe.
David gannar Bab-Jehováʼse egichialid: —¿Keila-dulemar Saúlʼga an-urmakoe? ¿An-sordagan urmaklemarmogoe? Bab-Jehová abin-sogded: —Eye, be-urmakmaloed.

Geb degine, David e-sordagan-dulataled-ilanergwa-merguedmala (600) Keila-neggweburgi-gudiidgi nadmalad, geb neg-baid-baid-onodii gusmalad. Saúlʼga sogsamargua, David Keila-neggweburgi-gudiid nadye, degisoggu, Saúl bar Keilaʼse nadsulid.
David yar-gwagwengi Zif-nega-dulesulidgangi negmar-dukued-bukwadgi dukudii gusad. Bane-bane Saúlʼdi amidii gusad, ar Bab-Dummaddi Saúlʼga David-urmaksasulid.
David Zif-nega-dulesulidgangi, Horesʼgi-gudiidgi wisgusad, Saúlʼdi e-oburgwega e-aminadye.
Saúl-machi-Jonatán, Horesʼse David-daknaded. Geb Jonatán, David mer-Bab-Dummadgi-bensuli-gudiguega, David-ogannosad.
Jonatán, Davidʼga weyob sogsad: “Melle be dobee-itoge, ar an-bab be-amiosulid. Israel-e-reyga be megoed, an be-sorbalidga guoed. We-ibmar an-babse-bakale, na wisid.”
Geb degine, ebogwa Bab-Jehová-asabin igar-mesismalad. A-sorbali, Jonatán na e-negse gannar nonikid. Davidʼdi, Horesʼgi gudii gusad.

Zifʼginmalad Gabaa-neggweburse nadmargu, Saúlʼga sogdapmalad: —Dummad, David anmar-yargi-dukudiidi, ¿be wissursi? Haquila-yargi gudiid, nega-dulesulidgan-dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik, Hores-neg-dukuedgi dukudiid.
Dummad, anmarse be naele, anmar bega David-urmakoed.
Saúl abin-sogded: —¡Bemar wile an-daked-ulale, Bab-Jehová begi nued binsamalana gadin!
Be namala, nue be wisgunamala, David bia gudii, doa daksabali. Ar anga sogsamalad, Davidʼde bato ibmar-wisdaye.
Biarmala David-dukue bemar nue wisgumalo, geb nuekwaa be anga sognonimalo. Geb agine, an bemarba naoed. Ar a-yargi nue-gudidibe, bela Judá-e-wagan-abargi an aminaoed.
Zifʼginmalad Saúlʼgi banguarmalad, geb e-yarse gannar nonimalad. Deunni, Davidʼdi e-sordaganmala Maón-nega-dulesulidgan-dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik, Arabáʼye-neg-nugadgi gudimalad.
David-owisosmargua, Saúl, e-sordaganmala be-amidanimarye, David, Maón-nega-dulesulidgangi akwasaila-siidse aidenonikid. Ar Saúl deyob wisguargua, Maón-nega-dulesulidgansik David-balegited.
Saúl yar-siid-dikarba nadapid, Davidʼdi e-sordaganmala, wakinmalaga gwae-gwae a-yar-dikar-baidsik nadapmogad. Degi-inigwele, Saúl, e-sordaganmala, David-ebiris bukusmalad. Nue-David-gasokarmargua,
dule-wargwen-gayaburba-berbeged nonikid, geb Saúlʼga sognonikid: “¡Dummad, gwae be gannar dage, ar Filisteaʼmar anmar-yargi ubosmalad!”
Geb degine, Saúl David-baleginnaid indaksasunnad. Geb Filisteaʼmarbo-urgwega gannar naded. A-ulale, we-neg Sela-Hama-Lecotʼye nug-imaksamalad.
A-sorbali, David, na dukuega Engadi-neg-dukumalad-bukwadse naded.
